chapter.v:
The Lord
told Moses,

“Tell the
Israelites: I am the Lord your God.

Don't follow
the ways of Egypt where you used to live, and don't follow the ways of Canaan where I'm going to take you. Don't adopt their practices.

Do what
I tell you and keep my rules. I am the Lord your God.

If you
keep my rules and do what I tell you, you will live. I am the Lord.

Don't have
sex with a close relative.

Don't shame
your father by having sex with your mother. She is your mother; don't have sex with her.

Don't have
sex with any of your father's wives and shame your father.

Don't have
sex with your sister, whether she's your father's daughter or your mother's daughter, or whether she was born in the same house as you or somewhere else.

Don't have
sex with your granddaughter, your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter, because that would be a shameful thing for you.

Don't have
sex with the daughter of any of your father's wives or the daughter of your father. She is your sister.

Don't have
sex with your father's sister. She is a close relative of your father.

Don't have
sex with your mother's sister. She is a close relative of your mother.

Don't bring
shame on your uncle by having sex with his wife. She is your aunt.

Don't have
sex with your daughter-in-law. She is your son's wife. Don't have sex with her.

Don't have
sex with your brother's wife and bring shame on your brother.

Don't have
sex with both a woman and her daughter. Don't have sex with her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter. They are her close relatives. That is something I loathe.

Don't marry
your wife's sister and have sex with her while your wife is still alive. They will be hostile wives to one other.

Don't have
sex with a woman during the time she is unclean because of her period.

Don't commit
any sex act with any other man's wife. This would pollute you and make you unclean.

Don't give
any of your children as a human sacrifice to Molech, for you must not disgrace the character of your God. I am the Lord.

Don't have
sex with a man as with a woman. That is something disgusting.

Don't have
sex with any animal. This would pollute you and make you unclean.

A woman
must not give herself to an animal to have sex with it. That is something disgusting. Don't pollute yourselves and make yourselves unclean by doing anything like this. That's the reason I'm expelling these nations from the land—they polluted themselves because of all these practices.

Even the
land has become polluted, so I am punishing it for the sins committed by the people who live there, and the land will vomit them out.

You, however,
must do what I tell you and keep my rules. You must not do any of these disgusting acts, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.

The people
who lived in the land before you practiced all these disgusting things, and the land became polluted.

If you
pollute the land, it will vomit you out just like it did the nations before you.

Consequently anyone
who does any of these disgusting things must be expelled from their people.

You must
accept my demand that you don't follow any of these disgusting practices done before you arrived. Don't pollute yourselves and make yourselves unclean. I am the Lord your God.”
